scope: Windows packaged executable with the launcher argument. Two independent private desktop processes drive the real campaign and persistence buttons using messages addressed only to their own windows. The clean extracted stock package also passes headless boot with the actual launcher. The tests use an isolated local profile, no Steam adapter or cloud connection and no physical mouse or keyboard.
